_comment: Tier-2 for dune::linear_elasticity (roller BCs lose a constraint at the shared corner). Two component-wise dune.ufl.DirichletBCs — [0,None] on x=0 and [None,0] on y=0, the standard symmetry/roller pair — leave the dof at (0,0) with only ONE of the two masks on dune-fem 2.12.0.2. Nothing is raised and the solve converges; the resulting global error is O(h^2), which reads as discretisation error. The fixture asserts (a) the corner dof does NOT satisfy both constraints, (b) swapping the two BCs in the scheme list changes nothing, so it is not last-wins, and (c) the CONTROL: two component-wise BCs on the SAME edge do merge, both components zero, which rules out 'masks never merge'. Verified by execution against dune-fem 2.12.0.2 on 2026-08-03: corner u_x = 1.910e-06 instead of 0 while u_y = 0, identical for both list orders, and the same-edge control gave max|u_x| = max|u_y| = 0. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 gives both edges a FULL [0, 0] mask instead of the two component-wise masks, so no component is left for the merge rule to drop at the shared corner. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'corner_constraint_dropped=True', 'dune_componentwise_bc_corner_trap_reproduced=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
